title: Snapmaker Orca · multiACE build
summary: Fixes the Multimaterial page segfault. Root cause found from a backtrace, not inference: a line carrying only a widget must set Line::full_width, or OptionsGroup::activate_line falls through to get_options().front() on an empty vector. Also renames the per-head groups so multiACE names only the section.

features.why: The Sync line had a widget but no full_width, so it missed the early return that tolerates option-less lines and null-dereferenced at ConfigOptionDef::gui_type (offset 0x30, matching RAX=0x0 in the trace).

features.what: Two earlier diagnoses were wrong and are recorded as such
features.why: i_enum_open on vector options, then an empty optgroup. Both were plausible, both were reverted or disproved, neither was the bug. PROGRESS.md keeps the trail.
multiACE is the layer and belongs on the section header only; the heads are fed by ACE units. It previously read multiACE five times on one page.
Reads /multiace/api/state, writes the topology into the preset, and reports divergence rather than silently correcting it.

features.what: ACE unit greys out on stock feeders
features.why: A live-but-meaningless field is what invited setting the unit instead of the capacity.

features.what: Debug config now builds alongside Release
features.why: Ninja Multi-Config, so build/src/Debug exists without disturbing the Release binary. -D_GLIBCXX_ASSERTIONS turns an out-of-bounds vector index into an abort at the line.

verify: Open Printer settings -> Multimaterial. It should not crash.
Headers read: multiACE (sync row), then Toolhead 1, 2, 3, 4.
Toolheads 1-3: ACE unit greyed out; Toolhead 4 (4 spool positions) editable.
Press Sync from printer: it reports a match, or offers to set Toolhead 4 to ACE 1.
Re-slice the cube and confirm ACE=0 still appears for head 3.
open: Assignment dialog: page and optimiser are built and verified, but the C++ webview host and its slot in the send flow are not written yet.
Swap cost is not surfaced anywhere in the UI - the test cube prices at 300 swaps ~ 15-20 m of purge.
Named 'Fed by' pickers stay mockup-only: they need the unit -1 = stock feeder data-model change plus vector support in Field.cpp.
The unguarded .front() in OptionsGroup.cpp:277 is upstream code and is left as-is.
tests: 207 unit assertions · 2 e2e scenarios · all passing
